name: Okuwa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Okuwa village emblem in white: an outlined stylised device of a peak and wings enclosing the character 大.
history: Municipal flag of Okuwa, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Okuwa village emblem — an outlined stylised device of a peak and wings enclosing the character 大
